label: Attorney discipline
caption: IN THE MATTER OF DISBARMENT OF DAVID JAY BERNSTEIN
text: David Jay Bernstein, of Coconut Creek, Florida, having been suspended from the practice of law in this Court by order of December 12, 2022; and a rule having been issued and served upon him requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred; and a response having been filed; It is ordered that David Jay Bernstein is disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
